firstName.description: Agent's first name. Minimum length is 1. Maximum length is 64.

lastName.description: Agent's last name. Minimum length is 1. Maximum length is 64.

type.description:
Type of the person, workspace or virtual line.
 * `PEOPLE` - Indicates that this object is a person.
 * `PLACE` - Indicates that this object is a workspace, formerly known as a place.
 * `VIRTUAL_LINE` - Indicates that this object is a virtual line.

phoneNumber.description: Agent's phone number. Minimum length is 1. Maximum length is 23.  Either `phoneNumber` or `extension` is mandatory.

extension.description: Agent's extension. Minimum length is 2. Maximum length is 10.  Either `phoneNumber` or `extension` is mandatory.

esn.description: Routing prefix + extension of a person or workspace.
